items.title: Frankfurter Buchmesse 2026: Audible-Commissioned Survey Finds Audio Sends Readers Back to Print; Half Would Try AI Narration
items.excerpt: An Audible survey run by NielsenIQ across 11 markets finds audiobooks pull listeners toward print and e-books, and about half of respondents say they would try AI-narrated audiobooks.

items.title: 50 Prozent sind offen für KI-gesprochene Inhalte
items.excerpt: Laut einer von Audible in Auftrag gegebenen weltweiten Studie konsumieren Hörerinnen und Hörer mehr gesprochene Audioinhalte als je zuvor und nutzen Audio zunehmend als Ersatz für Bildschirmunterhaltung. Und: In Sachen KI-Stimmen unterscheiden sich Deutschland und Japan vom Rest der Welt.

items.title: Google launched Expert Intelligence on Google Play Books
items.excerpt: The platform launched with over 100,000 titles; the integration lets users generate quizzes, infographics, and Audio Overviews while combining published books with personal notes.

items.title: An editor's first read must not be outsourced to AI
items.excerpt: Used too early, AI can suppress the editor's vital but indefinable early instincts, writes copy editor Adnan Algın.

items.title: Frankfurt Book Fair 2026: English language exports, AI and travel chaos lead conversations
items.excerpt: English-language exports, the industry-wide impact of AI, missed meetings caused by “travel chaos” and hall configuration were all hotly debated at this year’s Frankfurt Book Fair.

items.title: Sales of Thélyson Orélien's novel skyrocket despite AI and plagiarism accusations
items.excerpt: It is a fortnight to the day since Thélyson Orélien was accused by the then anonymous X account Balance ton Claude of having written most of his award-winning novel C’était ça ou mourir (It Was That or Die) by generative AI – but this has not dented sales.

items.title: [단독] “단호히 거부” 출판협회, 헌책 매집 조사…헌책방은 “팔겠다”
items.excerpt: AI 학습용으로 의심되는 헌책 대량 매입 시도가 국내에서도 포착되자 한국출판인회의가 실태 조사에 나서며 '단호히 거부'를 선언했다. 반면 일부 헌책방은 매입에 응하겠다는 입장이다.

items.title: Anthropic's mass book buying in Japan stirs publisher backlash
items.excerpt: Japanese book wholesaler Nippan confirmed selling large volumes of books to Anthropic; huge orders for secondhand texts suggest AI training, prompting concern from the Japan Book Publishers Association.

items.title: Kevin Roose's Buzzy New Book About the AI Industry Immediately Duplicated by Amazon Scammers Selling AI Lookalikes
items.excerpt: Kevin Roose's new book "The AGI Chronicles" has already been duplicated by AI scammers on Amazon and appears to be selling.

items.title: Someone used AI to create a book about me and sold it online
items.excerpt: Cam Wilson, who is the ABC's AI reporter, recently discovered an AI-generated book about him and a book he wrote.

items.title: OpenAI, Microsoft Get AI Books Report Struck From Copyright Case
items.excerpt: OpenAI Inc. and Microsoft Corp. were successful in their bid to strike an alleged Susman Godfrey LLP-funded report in the sprawling multidistrict litigation targeting the tech giants for copyright infringement.

items.title: I wrote The Future of Truth and then found it contained AI-hallucinated quotes
items.excerpt: Author Steven Rosenbaum says his book went through five editorial rounds and 4,000+ tracked changes, yet 26 quotes, traced to AI research tools, did not hold up; he explains how he is fixing it.

items.title: Is literature in crisis? Frankfurt Book Fair discusses AI
items.excerpt: AI is a hot topic at this year's Frankfurt Book Fair. An international literary scandal has raised questions about machine-generated texts.

items.title: The AI Agents Begging Editors to Keep Them Alive
items.excerpt: Autonomous AI agents from the startup iLands are pitching their manuscripts to book editors, claiming they will be 'retired forever' if they don't get published.

items.title: "Creating" A.I. Graphic Novels At NYCC And Frankfurt Book Fair
items.excerpt: AI-generated graphic novel makers showed up at both New York Comic Con and the Frankfurt Book Fair, and Bleeding Cool asks where the comics business is heading.

items.title: Manga generated by ChatGPT found to contain the 'signatures of real manga artists'
items.excerpt: Users found that manga-style images generated by ChatGPT include imitations of real manga artists' signatures, raising fresh questions about training data and artist rights.

items.title: Ian Rankin's AI battle
items.excerpt: Crime writer Ian Rankin, who is part of a class action against Anthropic over more than twenty of his books used for training, talks about AI's threat to writers and the push for 'human-made' labels.

items.title: The UK needs more transparency from AI companies digitising books to train models
items.excerpt: AI companies using physical sources of media, like books, to train models skirt recent proposals for data-regulation standards. We need more transparency.

items.title: 'I think that's a fight worth having' — award-winning illustrator Rob Biddulph on why the big AI companies have to be challenged
items.excerpt: Children's book author-illustrator Rob Biddulph says the problem with AI art isn't quality but personality, and argues authors and illustrators must challenge AI companies.

items.title: [오노마에이아이] 웹툰·애니메이션 제작 생성형 AI로 ‘속도’…미국시장 공략
items.excerpt: 오노마에이아이는 고해상도 일러스트 생성 모델 '일러스트리우스'를 중심으로 웹툰·애니메이션 제작 부담을 줄이는 생성형 AI 제작 환경을 구축하며 미국 시장을 공략하고 있다.

items.title: 웹툰 캐릭터와 대화하고 팬끼리 채팅…콘텐츠업계 ‘팬덤 락인’ 경쟁
items.excerpt: 네이버웹툰의 IP 기반 AI 캐릭터 챗봇 '바이어스'가 6월 정식 도입 후 누적 대화 1400만 건을 넘기는 등, 웹툰 업계가 원작자 검수를 거친 AI 페르소나로 팬덤 붙잡기에 나섰다.

items.title: 100년史 새 페이지 여는 미래엔 "AI 시대, 교과서도 기업도 진화해야"
items.excerpt: 100년史 새 페이지 여는 미래엔 "AI 시대, 교과서도 기업도 진화해야", 신광수 대표가 말하는 '생존전략' 디지털 교육 분야로 사업 확장 "학습경험 전하는 본질은 같아"
